note: Strip-wide survey of poker rooms that were not yet covered by the venue dataset (data/tournaments.json). Every official value below was read on 2026-11-17 from the operator page, PDF or article named in its sources list, and carries the excerpt it came from. A closure reported only by the press is kept in reported_changes, never in an official field. Nothing here is a dated row: a weekly or recurring schedule with no calendar date is not turned into dated tournaments.

rooms.name: MGM Grand
rooms.tournament_summary: Official page lists daily Texas Hold'em tournaments at 11:00am, 7:00pm and 11:00pm. The official weekly schedule PDF prints 11:10am, 7:10pm and 11:10pm (flag S1).

rooms.name: Mandalay Bay
rooms.status: open (official poker page read 2026-11-17); closed Tuesdays
rooms.hours: Wednesday to Monday 10:00 AM to 4:00 AM; Tuesday closed (official poker page)
rooms.contact: For reservations 702.632.7790; group tournaments: same number (official poker page)
rooms.tournament_summary: The official poker page publishes no tournament schedule: "Please Visit or Call Poker Room for Details". Third-party listings show daily $60 and $100 events; they are not official and are not used (flag S4).

rooms.name: Horseshoe Las Vegas
rooms.status: open per the Caesars official poker article (dated 2026-07-17, read 2026-11-17)
rooms.hours: Not printed in the article read
rooms.contact: Not printed in the article read
rooms.tournament_summary: The Caesars article says Horseshoe runs six daily No-Limit Hold'em tournaments at 9 a.m., 11 a.m., 2 p.m., 5 p.m., 8 p.m. and 11 p.m., with "a mixture of buy-ins, levels and guarantees". No single buy-in, guarantee or structure is printed for any of them (flag S5).

formats.name: $120 No Limit Hold'em (daily, 11:10 AM)
formats.chips_note: 25,000 chips including 10,000 bought with the optional $11 gratuity; 15,000 without it (structure PDF)
formats.fee_split: $92 prize pool; $13 house fee; $11 optional gratuity that grants 10,000 extra chips; $4 tournament promotions
formats.late_registration: Registration is open until Level 8 (structure PDF)
formats.separate_reason: The $11 gratuity is optional and buys 10,000 extra chips (a 67% larger starting stack). That is an advantage bought with extra money, so the format sits in the separate section.
formats.single_entry: Not stated. The structure PDF has no re-entry clause and no single-entry clause. Per the dataset rule, silence on re-entry does not prove single entry.
formats.payout_note: Payout percentages printed by entry count, from 1-14 entries (65/35) to the 85-91 entry row (structure PDF)
formats.excerpt: "Each initial $120 buy-in is allocated as follows: $92 to Prize Pool, $13 House Fee and a onetime, voluntary gratuity of $11 which grants players an extra 10,000 chips. $4 will fund Tournament Promotions."

reported_changes.change: Poker room to close on 30 March 2026

reported_changes.reported_by: Las Vegas Review-Journal, 28 January 2026, quoting a Caesars Entertainment statement: "This consolidation is designed to better match current demand and enhance the player experience."

strip_coverage.basis: Strip rooms that Casino.org listed as still open in March 2026 (Aria, Bellagio, Caesars Palace, Horseshoe, Mandalay Bay, MGM Grand, Venetian, Wynn), plus the two rooms reported closed. Other Strip resorts were not surveyed in this session (flag S10).
